app.title: Fretboard Lab — Explore, Chords & Profiles
app.tagline: Interactive guitar fretboard — explore scales & CAGED, analyze chords, save your guitar profiles
app.footer: Fretboard Lab · hover a note for details · click a note to hear it · move your mouse to explore

guitarChip.title: Choose which guitar to use on the fretboard
guitarChip.emptyProfiles: No saved guitars yet — add some in Profiles

chords.label: Chord Analyzer
chords.compoundTitle: Simple = within-octave (2, 4, 6). Compound = extensions (9, 11, 13) when the chord has them.

legend.hintCaged: CAGED shapes (C · A · G · E · D) are 5-fret windows with the root on the 2nd fret of each box. Toggle shapes below; turn the layer off for a full-neck scale view. Hover a note for details.
legend.hintFullScale: Full-scale view of the selected root, scale, and mode. Turn on CAGED shapes to overlay the five movable boxes. Degrees are chromatic Romans; intervals are qualities relative to the root.
legend.hintChords: Move the mouse over the neck — a gold outline snaps to the nearest string/fret; click to place a note, click a placed note to remove it. Proposed scales can be previewed or ✦-wired into Explore.

tipbox.exploreBody: root {root} · {scale}{modePart} · {layer}. Markers show note name, Roman degree and interval quality relative to root.
tipbox.chordsBody: place notes by clicking the fretboard; click a placed note again to remove it. The app names the chord and shows each note’s role relative to its root.

chords.empty: No notes yet — click the fretboard to place notes and detect a chord.
chords.noScales: No library scales contain this chord in {root}

profiles.title: My Guitars
profiles.hint: Save your instruments — body type, role, scale length, tuning and a photo.
profiles.useGuitar: Use this guitar across Fretboard Lab
profiles.usingGuitar: Using this guitar across Fretboard Lab — click to unset
profiles.name: Name
profiles.cropHint: Drag to move · drag the corner to resize
profiles.confirmRemoveBody: Are you sure you want to remove {name}? This cannot be undone.
profiles.confirmImportBody: Importing replaces everything on this device: {currentCount} guitar(s) currently saved will be replaced by {importedCount} from the backup. Tunings, fret counts, scales and playback settings are restored too.
profiles.saveStorageFull: Could not save — local storage is full. Try a smaller photo or remove some guitars.
profiles.imageLoadError: Could not load this image. Some formats (e.g. iPhone HEIC) are not supported — try a JPG or PNG.
profiles.imageNoDimensions: This image has no usable dimensions.
profiles.importInvalidZip: Not a valid Fretboard Lab export — the file could not be read as a ZIP archive.
profiles.importNoSettings: Not a Fretboard Lab export — no settings file inside the ZIP.
profiles.importCorruptJson: The export is corrupted — its settings file is not valid JSON.
profiles.importUnknownFormat: Not a Fretboard Lab export — the settings file has an unknown format.
profiles.importNewerVersion: This export was made by a newer version of Fretboard Lab and cannot be imported here.

Ionian.desc: The major scale itself. No real tension to resolve тАФ the sound of home and a happy ending.

Dorian.desc: A minor scale with a bright 6th. Santana solos, Irish folk, and modal jazz тАФ sadness that still smiles.

Phrygian.desc: The тЩн2 gives it a distinctly Spanish / Andalusian flavor. Flamenco and heavy-metal riffs live here.

Lydian.desc: The тЩп4 makes everything feel airy and unresolved тАФ film scores, dream-pop shimmer, classic Sci-Fi wonder.

Mixolydian.desc: The major scale with a bluesy flattened 7th тАФ the sound of rock, blues, and Irish folk.

Aeolian.desc: The natural minor scale тАФ Western musicТs default for sadness, drama and dark emotion.

Locrian.desc: The tonic triad is diminished, so nothing ever truly resolves тАФ dread, chaos, and deliberate УwrongnessФ.

Harmonic Minor.desc: The raised 7th over a тЩн6 creates a signature leap тАФ klezmer, gypsy, metal and classical minor melodies.

Locrian #6.desc: Locrian with a raised 6th тАФ shadowy and unstable.

Ionian #5.desc: A major scale with a sharpened 5th тАФ chords wobble between major and augmented.

Dorian #4.desc: Dorian with a raised 4th тАФ a jazzy, slightly exotic minor sound.

Phrygian Major.desc: Also called Phrygian Dominant тАФ the Andalusian sound of flamenco, gypsy jazz and Middle-Eastern metal.

Altered bb7.desc: An altered dominant scale full of chromatic tension.

Melodic Minor.desc: The jazz minor тАФ a minor scale that rises with a major sound, a favorite for soloing over minor chords.

Dorian b2.desc: Dorian with a flattened 2nd тАФ dark and exotic.

Lydian Augmented.desc: Lydian with a raised 5th тАФ floating, majestic film-score material.

Lydian Dominant.desc: A dominant 7 chord with a тЩп11 тАФ the jazz-fusion and bebop dominant sound.

Mixolydian b6.desc: A dominant scale that bends toward minor тАФ melancholic.

Locrian #2.desc: Locrian with a raised 2nd тАФ dark and unstable.

Super Locrian.desc: The altered scale тАФ every note is a tension note, built for playing over altered dominant chords.

Phrygian Dominant.desc: The Andalusian sound of flamenco, gypsy jazz and Middle-Eastern metal тАФ a dominant chord with a flat 2nd.

Harmonic Major.desc: The major scale with a flattened 6th тАФ Ravel and jazz harmony love its dual major/minor colors.

Dorian b5.desc: Dorian with a flattened 5th тАФ a minor sound with a diminished core.

Phrygian b4.desc: Phrygian with a flattened 4th тАФ an unusual, ancient-sounding color.

Lydian b3.desc: Lydian bent toward minor тАФ the tonic wavers between major and minor.

Mixolydian b2.desc: A dominant sound with a Phrygian lean тАФ tense and dramatic.

Lydian Augmented #2.desc: An extreme Lydian variant with three raised notes.

Locrian bb7.desc: Locrian with a doubly-flattened 7th тАФ a fully diminished flavor.

Double Harmonic Major.desc: The famous "double harmonic" sound тАФ Jewish prayer, Arabic maqam, gypsy music.

Lydian #2 #6.desc: An exotic Lydian variant with raised 2nd and 6th.

Ultraphrygian.desc: Phrygian with a flattened 4th too тАФ very dark and unusual.

Hungarian Minor.desc: The gypsy minor scale тАФ two augmented 2nds, one minor 3rd, very dramatic.

Oriental.desc: A double-harmonic variant with a raised 4th тАФ snake-charmer exotica.

Ionian b2 b5.desc: A major scale with two flattened notes тАФ uneasy and rare.

Locrian b3 bb7.desc: Doubly flattened тАФ even darker than ordinary Locrian.

Neapolitan Major.desc: The Neapolitan sound тАФ a major scale with a flat 2nd, used for dramatic classical cadences.

Leading Whole Tone.desc: Mostly whole steps over a flat 2nd тАФ a dreamy, unstable Neapolitan mode.

Lydian #5 b7.desc: A dominant Lydian variant with a raised 5th.

Lydian b6 b7.desc: Lydian bent minor тАФ a haunting raised-4th color.

Major Locrian.desc: Locrian with a major 3rd тАФ an exotic diminished-major clash.

Ionian #4 b6.desc: Major with raised 4th and flattened 6th тАФ odd and rare.

Phrygian #2 #4.desc: Phrygian with raised 2nd and 4th тАФ exotic and unstable.

Neapolitan Minor.desc: The Neapolitan minor тАФ a dark classical mode with a flat 2nd.

Phrygian #3.desc: A Phrygian-dominant-like sound тАФ flamenco and Arabic color.

Mixolydian #2.desc: A dominant mode with a sharpened 2nd.

Lydian #2 b6.desc: Lydian bent minor with a raised 2nd тАФ dark and rare.

majorPentatonic.desc: Five notes with no half-steps тАФ almost impossible to sound wrong. Pop, folk, country and blues.

minorPentatonic.desc: The go-to scale for rock and blues guitar solos.

blues.desc: Minor pentatonic with a flattened 5th тАФ the note that bends and wails.

dominant.desc: The Mixolydian sound тАФ a dominant scale for bluesy rock.

wholeTone.desc: No tonal center at all тАФ Debussy and jazz use it for a hazy, unsettled shimmer.

diminished.desc: Alternating whole and half steps тАФ an 8-note scale full of built-in tension.

augmented.desc: Two augmented triads stacked тАФ Debussy and Ravel use it for a hazy, glowing sound.

diminishedHW.desc: The half-whole diminished тАФ the classic dominant-altered scale.

chromatic.desc: All twelve notes тАФ total chromatic color, atonal and free.

messiaen3.desc: MessiaenТs Mode 3 тАФ a symmetrical 9-note scale with a liturgical shimmer.

messiaen4.desc: Messiaen Mode 4 тАФ an 8-note symmetrical scale.

messiaen5.desc: Messiaen Mode 5 тАФ a sparse 6-note symmetric scale.

messiaen6.desc: Messiaen Mode 6 тАФ two interlocking tritone shapes.

messiaen7.desc: MessiaenТs Mode 7 тАФ an almost-chromatic scale of 10 notes.

suspendedPentatonic.desc: The Egyptian / Yo scale тАФ a pentatonic with a suspended, open sound.

dominantPentatonic.desc: Pentatonic built on the dominant notes тАФ a blues-friendly five-note set.

hirajoshi.desc: A classic koto tuning scale тАФ sparse and evocative.

iwato.desc: A dark Japanese scale with flat 2nd and flat 5th.

insen.desc: Another traditional Japanese scale тАФ sparse and elegant.

pelog.desc: A Javanese/Balinese gamelan scale of seven tones.

marwa.desc: An Arabic maqam scale тАФ dark and dignified.

bluesMajor.char: adds the тЩн3 to major pentatonic
bluesMajor.desc: The major blues scale тАФ a bright pentatonic with a passing blue note.

hexatonicMajor.desc: A six-note major scale with a wide gap between 5th and 7th.

hexatonicMinor.desc: A six-note minor scale with big expressive leaps.

prometheus.desc: The Scriabin "mystic" chord scale тАФ mystical and brooding.

bebopDominant.desc: Dominant with a chromatic passing note тАФ bebop phrasing flows smoothly.

bebopMajor.desc: Major with a passing chromatic тАФ the classic bebop scale.

bebopMinor.desc: Minor with a chromatic passing note between 3rd and 5th.

bebopDorian.desc: Dorian with a passing chromatic тАФ funky and fluid.

bebopLocrian.desc: Locrian with a passing note тАФ tense and chromatic.

minorSixDiminished.desc: The Barry Harris minor scale тАФ a minor sound with a sharp 7th.

majorSixDiminished.desc: The Barry Harris major scale тАФ major with a passing chromatic 3rd.

persian.desc: The Persian scale тАФ exotic and regal, used in traditional Persian music.

enigmatic.desc: A theatrical scale from Italian opera тАФ dark, chromatic and grand.

spanishPhrygian.desc: The flamenco scale тАФ Phrygian with a raised 3rd and a тЩн7.

todi.desc: A Hindustani raga scale тАФ devotional and serious.

purvi.desc: A raga scale built on double-harmonic color.

phrygianNatural6.desc: Phrygian with a raised 6th тАФ a folk Andalusian sound.

mixolydianAugmented.desc: A dominant scale with a raised 5th тАФ bright and tense.

lydianMinor.desc: Lydian bent toward minor тАФ airy and unresolved.

hungarianMajor.desc: The Hungarian gypsy major тАФ dark, fiery and folk-inflected.

locrianNatural2.desc: Locrian with a natural 2nd тАФ dissonant but less sharp.
